verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a Banking-as-a-Service offering that lets platforms programmatically create accounts for their customers, with local bank details in 60+ markets and balances in 20 currencies, via connected accounts. However, no evidence says platforms can do this without holding their own financial license (e.g., Airwallex acting as the licensed entity). missing for 10: explicit documentation of licensing coverage or a regulatory-responsibility model, independent or hands-on corroboration of embedded-account onboarding.

support.subject: As a developer, I can offer embedded banking accounts to my customers without holding my own financial license

citations.quote: Programmatically create accounts with local bank details to collect in 60+ markets for your customers
Allow customers to hold funds in 20 currencies, convert currencies at interbank rates
Programmatically create connected accounts for businesses and individuals, and enable them with rich financial capabilities.
